messages:
Leah (CS): quick weekly pulse for EmberTrack — usage +12% w/w, spend +8%, error rate ~0.7% overall. dropping a p95/p99 split by route/model + streaming vs non-streaming below.

Tom (Eng): pasted telemetry from the console (rolling 7d)
```
/route         | model         | streaming p95 / p99 | non-stream p95 / p99
/generate      | redwood-large | 180ms / 420ms       | 230ms / 560ms
/chat          | llama-13b     | 210ms / 650ms       | 280ms / 920ms
/embed         | opt-2.7       | 50ms  / 120ms       | 75ms  / 160ms
/rerank        | bert-lite     | 95ms  / 240ms       | 110ms / 310ms
```

Leah (CS): main callouts — chat non-stream p99 up to 920ms (highest risk for timeouts on mobile). generate shows streaming advantage ~20% at p95 but p99 still elevated. embed is fine.

Ravi (SRE): confirmed spike correlates with two bursts last Tue evening — saw queueing on the canary pool between 18:20-18:45 UTC. SLOs were breached for chat non-stream p99 (~12m window). I created INC-4872 and added traces.

Priya (PM): customer reports slow replies when users hit long-context flows. They're onboarding 3 power-users this week. Renewal due Q3 — we should avoid more regressions.

Tom (Eng): quick triage notes:
- suspect KV-cache miss rate increased for chat (prefix patterns changed after new prompt template).
- canary model variant (llama-13b-quant) saw a slow sigmoid in kernel selection under certain seq lengths.
- plan: enable extra batching on low-priority routes, bump canary back to baseline if not stable.

Leah (CS): action items:
- @Tom: run a targeted cache-eviction analysis + share sample traces by EOD (tomorrow).
- @Ravi: keep INC-4872 on P1 and add the timeline for the breach.
- @Priya: recommend customers postpone rolling out the new prompt template to power-users until next deploy.

Tom (Eng): on it. also going to validate fallback policy — if streaming backend is overloaded, we should fall back to a lighter quantized variant with explicit notice to the app (less latency variance).

Ravi (SRE): logs I pushed to the thread: deploy-bot shows a small model build around the time, but not a full rollout. tagging @deploy-bot for build-id.

deploy-bot: build 202210-llama13b-quant completed at 18:15 UTC on Tue, no cluster-wide rollout.

Priya (PM): for the customer enablement thread — can CS get a one-pager on recommended prompt length limits + batching best practices? I can include it in their onboarding docs.

Leah (CS): yes, I'll draft a short guidance doc and a checklist for the power-users. will include suggestions: prefer streaming for chat when possible, cap initial context to 6k tokens, avoid mixing long system + long user in same request.

Tom (Eng): follow-up telemetry item: we'll add an ephemeral KV cache hit-rate dashboard for EmberTrack routes and an alert if p99 for chat non-stream crosses 750ms for >5m.

Ravi (SRE): putting tentative remediation timeline: today - traces + INC notes; tomorrow - cache analysis; Thu - config canary and alerting; Fri - customer-facing note if stable.

Priya (PM): thanks — if we hit the timeline, I think renewal risk is low. keep me posted on the cache numbers. :thumbsup:

Leah (CS): thanks team. I'll update the customer and post the one-pager once the cache analysis is in. closing loop next weekly sync. :calendar:
